name: Freezer Cole Slaw
description: A freezer coleslaw recipe with a sweet and tangy dressing, made with grated cabbage and optional vegetables.

recipeInstructions.text: Heat together vinegar, sugar, salt, water, celery seed, and mustard to make the syrup.
Grate or chop cabbage and other vegetables in a food processor.
Cover the cabbage mixture with the syrup and refrigerate overnight.
Place in a container, seal, and freeze.

_similar.name: Cabbage Rolls
_similar.description: Traditional cabbage rolls filled with a savory mixture of ground pork, beef, and rice, simmered in tomato juice.

recipeInstructions.text: Boil the cabbage head for 10 minutes to soften the leaves. Drain and let cool.
Chop the onion and fry in lard for 10 minutes until softened.
Mix the cooked onion and lard with ground pork, ground beef, rice, salt, and pepper until well combined.
Peel off cabbage leaves and cut out the thick stem. Place about 1 tablespoon of the meat mixture in the center of each leaf, fold the sides, and roll into a neat package.
Line the bottom of a large pot with a layer of cabbage leaves to prevent burning.
Arrange the cabbage rolls seam-side down in the pot, layering them as needed.
Pour the tomato juice over the cabbage rolls, ensuring they are mostly covered.
Bring the tomato juice to a simmer, then reduce heat and let cook for the entire afternoon (approximately 3 hours).

_similar.keywords: cabbage rolls, stuffed cabbage, ground meat, comfort food

_similar.name: Sauerkraut Salad
_similar.description: A tangy and crunchy salad featuring sauerkraut, chopped vegetables, and a sweet-and-sour dressing that keeps well in the refrigerator.
recipeIngredient: 1 (28 oz) jar or can sauerkraut, drained

recipeInstructions.text: Heat the vinegar, sugar, and salt in a saucepan until boiling.
Let the dressing cool to room temperature.
In a large bowl, combine the drained sauerkraut, chopped celery, onion, red pepper, and green pepper.
Pour the cooled dressing over the salad and toss to coat.
Store in a sealed container in the refrigerator for up to 2-3 weeks.

_similar.keywords: sauerkraut salad, tangy salad, make-ahead salad
